records.title: TwinFormer: A Dual-Level Transformer for Long-Sequence Time-Series Forecasting
records.reason: TwinFormer applies patching, top-k sparse attention, and GRU aggregation to long-sequence time-series forecasting. The paper reports linear sequence-length complexity and consumer-GPU forecasting, but the target is time-series prediction, not LLM inference or serving; the architectural analogy alone does not establish an LLM lineage match.

records.title: RAST-MoE-RL: A Regime-Aware Spatio-Temporal MoE Framework for Deep Reinforcement Learning in Ride-Hailing
records.reason: RAST-MoE-RL is a policy/representation framework for ride-hailing dispatch trained with reinforcement learning. Its MoE experts serve urban demand regimes and improve matching/pickup outcomes; it does not address LLMs, language generation, or LLM inference efficiency.
